newsitem.title: UK: ONS says UK imported coffee prices dip in June.
newsitem.headline: ONS says UK imported coffee prices dip in June.

text.p: The price of coffee imported to the UK slumped by 17.4 percent in June, following a 20 year record rise of 11.0 percent in May, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
The record rise in May was attributable to a winter frost, low stocks and the tight Latin American supply situation, the ONS said.

There was a drop of 8.8 percent between May and June in the prices of home produced pigs for slaughter, partially reversing a large rise in May. There was also a seasonal 11.9-percent fall between May and June in home produced lambs for slaughter.
